standalone_timings.scope: Standalone serial paired order after training. Training uses throwaway model copies initialized from seed1 final checkpoint, five optimizer warmup steps, no saved checkpoint altered. Inference follows those bounded throwaway steps, so it is a shape/runtime benchmark rather than quality evaluation.
